source.stem:
Plant cells are often green but animal cells are not usually green.
Which structure in plant cells makes them green?

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: A cell taken from a multicellular organism is itself a complete organism.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: A bacterium is an incomplete living organism.

intelligence.enrichment: Some microorganisms, such as bacteria and protozoa, are unicellular organisms. They carry out all functions necessary for survival in a single cell, while multicellular organisms are made of many cells. Number of cells in the organism -> unicellular or multicellular organisation -> survival functions occur in one cell or across many cells. The learner correctly applies this rule: Some microorganisms, such as bacteria and protozoa, are unicellular organisms. They carry out all functions necessary for survival in a single cell, while multicellular organisms are made of many cells. A real organism needs many parts and many cells, so one cell cannot be a whole living organism.
